data.exact_reserve_text: In 2020, there has been an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 6.0m (2019: GBP 24.6m) due to lower than expected incurred movements across most classes of business.

Better than expected performance on the large Irish motor account (written 2012-16) generated a substantial part of a gross back-year release.

data.standardized_narrative: During calendar 2020 Syndicate 2791 experienced overall favourable reserve development on prior years. The syndicate reports an overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 6.0m for 2020 driven by lower-than-expected incurred movements and better-than-expected reserve utilisation on back years (notably 2017 and prior). Key contributors cited include favourable development on long-tail casualty lines, releases on short-tail items and a beneficial outcome from a reinsurance arbitration on a Canadian wildfire contract. The syndicate continues to carry specific reserves for named prior events (e.g. Superstorm Sandy, 2010 Japanese earthquake/2011 Thai floods) and maintains provisions for 2020 exposures such as Hurricane Laura and COVID-19 with uncertainty noted.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (total) was found in the report's 'movement in prior year's provision' note for calendar 2020. The report gives net prior-year outcomes (e.g. 'overall net surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 6.0m') and various gross back-year releases are quoted in different sections (some relating to the closed 2018 underwriting year). A gross PYD figure aggregating all prior underwriting years for 2020 could not be unambiguously determined from the available gross movement notes without reconstructing from the claims triangle (which is present but contains aggregate 'and prior' columns and RITC activity that distort simple diagonal comparisons). Accordingly prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null and the net surplus sentence is provided in exact_reserve_text. RITC activity with Syndicate 6103 and USD-denominated event quantifications in text add complexity to extracting a single gross PYD value.
